page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.32xlarge is a memory-optimized cloud instance built on the x86_64 architecture and managed via the KVM hypervisor. The physical host utilizes an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. This configuration features 128 dedicated vCPUs paired with 1024.0 GB of system memory, resulting in an allocation ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

Network infrastructure for this instance size includes a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps. Bundled local ephemeral storage is not provided, requiring reliance on external block storage solutions for disk operations. No integrated GPU accelerators are present in this instance specification.

The 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio delivers high memory density per instance, providing strong qualitative resource efficiency for applications bound by RAM capacity rather than compute cycles. Tradeoffs include the absence of onboard local storage and dedicated hardware accelerators. Suitable workload fits include enterprise in-memory databases, large-scale caching systems, big data analytics processes, and memory-intensive enterprise software deployments.
